# Active Movers & Packers

> Professional movers and packers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. For quotes and booking, call +251982260000 (0982260000) or use the online booking form.

Active Movers & Packers provides local residential moving, office relocation, packaging, and storage across Addis Ababa. Starting prices are published on the homepage; final quotes follow a site visit or inventory call.

## Prices and guides

Published starting prices (2026, typical in-city moves): studio from 17,000 ETB; 2-bedroom condo from 22,000 ETB; 3-bedroom from 28,000 ETB; villa from 38,000 ETB; office relocation from 45,000 ETB. Stair carry or no service lift often adds 2,000–5,000 ETB.
